recentItems.title: China-Kyrgyzstan cooperation fuels regional connectivity for shared growth: Kyrgyz expert
recentItems.description:
Rooted in the ancient #SilkRoad, the #China- #Kyrgyzstan cooperation not only sets a gold standard for good neighborliness, but also actively promotes regional #connectivity and people-to-people ties, said Sheradil Baktygulov, director of the Kyrgyz Institute of World Politics.
Progress on the landmark China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan railway, he noted, goes beyond #infrastructure -- it unlocks new potential for #CentralAsia for a true win-win outcome.
#BeltAndRoad #BRI #Infrastructure

recentItems.title: Chinese-built waste-to-energy plant injects new impetus into Bishkek's green transition
recentItems.description: Launched in December 2025, a Chinese-built waste-to-energy plant, which generates electricity from solid waste recycling, has been injecting new impetus into Bishkek's green transition. #GLOBALink
